english: Travels along a light trajectory with slight homing and sticks to enemies or surfaces before exploding after a brief delay. The explosion deals up to <pve 738 /> <pvp [130] /> damage and applies 40+20 stacks of <solar Scorch /> in a 6 meter radius.

source.text:
Light Trajectory | Slightly Homing | Sticky

Attaches to enemies or surfaces, exploding after a brief delay.

Explosion deals up to 738 [130] damage and inflict x40+20 Scorch over 6 meters on detonation.
Base Cooldown: 95.8 seconds

Chunk Scalar:  1x
